name: Coefficient Ratio of the Incompatible Gated Amalgam
parameters: The two 25-concept gated pieces $A$ and $B$ both have coefficient ratio zero.
scope: The 33-concept union $X_{33}$ on seven positioned coordinates.
proof: Opposite deterministic entropy circulations in the two pieces combine to a zero-entropy global balance and give the lower bound one. Explicit all-one coefficient arrays have maximum ratio at most $1+5\varepsilon$ for every $\varepsilon>0$, giving the upper bound one.
